question: Where must the seed-syllable hrīṃ be inscribed within the constructed eight-petaled lotus?
premises: An eight-petaled lotus is to be made as part of the diagram.
The pericarp of that lotus serves as the designated location.
The seed-syllable hrīṃ is the element to be written.
inference: After constructing the eight-petaled lotus, the practitioner should inscribe hrīṃ in its pericarp.
uncertainties: The form karṇikāyān is taken as indicating location in the pericarp, though its exact number reading is not fully certain.
plain_english: Having made an eight-petaled lotus, one should then write hrīṃ in its pericarp.
